capabilities: Import fonts from the Fontsource directory
Apply imported fonts to interface, text, or monospace roles
Order multiple fonts per role by precedence for language coverage
Cache imported WOFF2 fonts locally as CSS files
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12 or newer. Connects to api.fontsource.org and cdn.jsdelivr.net only while listing or importing fonts; fonts then load from a local cache under the vault's configured Obsidian folder.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to import and assign custom web fonts from a font directory to its interface and editor.
summary: Font loader that imports fonts from the Fontsource directory and applies them to Obsidian's interface, text, or monospace roles.
